reasoning: This is a single-arm study of pembrolizumab in elderly NSCLC patients. Step 2 (PATHWAY MODULATION): No immune activation biomarkers reported, but PD-L1 subgroup analysis suggests pathway relevance. Step 3 (CLINICAL TRANSLATION): Median OS of 19.2 months appears reasonable for this population, but without a control arm or historical comparison, efficacy assessment is limited. Step 4 (POPULATION EFFECTS): Clear PD-L1-dependent response with high expressors (≥50%) achieving 23.3 months median OS vs 16.5 months in low expressors, suggesting mechanism works preferentially in biomarker-positive subset. Step 5 (CONFOUNDERS): Single-arm design prevents definitive efficacy assessment; elderly population may have different response profile.
